title: Shiraishi An — Assistant Screenwriter〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, here you are.
It's still hot, so be careful.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks!
What's a movie without popcorn, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do I really need to be here for this screening...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, quit acting all embarrassed!
You're the lead, so you should sit and be proud of your work♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: An, the projector's ready to go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, let's start while all the food's still warm!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Today's screening of “The Wandering Cook: A Post-Apocalyptic Tale of Gourmet Martial Arts” begins... Now!

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“Far in the future...
A series of disasters has led humanity to the brink of extinction...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
I thought my heart was gonna explode when we showed this at the gym.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It was the first time having so many people see my face up on the big screen like that.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I feel a lot better about it now after hearing them say the film was really good...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Cool...!
Akito's got some serious acting chops!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And the stunts look so real.
You can hardly tell that they're using a double.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “I want things to be like they were before... I want to see you smiling again...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I sing a song in the hopes that my mom's sickness goes away...)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “And so, the Wandering Cook resumed his journey to help those in need of good food.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “He would venture back into the wastes, but a figure kept watching over him. The girl as she awaited his return.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I was so staggered during the climax, Akito! Was that you doing all your own stunts?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That part when you got surrounded felt so real! I couldn't believe what I was seeing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I'm glad you all enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
An even sang a wonderful song.
I was so surprised at first since it wasn't anything like what you normally sing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. It was like I was hearing that girl sing instead of you, An.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Congratulations, An!
I didn't know you had this sort of talent!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! I really appreciate the compliments!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But I have to say...
That was only possible because of our amazing director.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The director? Oh, you mean Kusanagi...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
She gave me so many awesome pointers for singing while acting.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She taught me how to stay in character while singing, and helped me figure out what the girl should be feeling during the song.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also... She showed me how she'd sing that song if she were playing the girl.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, based on her example, I tried singing that song as best I could.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really didn't know what it meant to sing in character at first... But trying something new ended up being so much fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
She certainly sounds like a wonderful director.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm so happy for you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Shooting our own film was so awesome!
I really wanna make another one together sometime.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Without me as the lead next time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
But I'm so glad this ended up becoming such a wonderful memory for you two.
